facts.text: Sir Alfred, the seven-foot undead knight with a greatsword, lies incapacitated but not destroyed in the Barrow Mound and may rise to attack the party if they return.
Sir Alfred, left incapacitated but not destroyed in the lower Barrow Mound, may recover and kill the Free Goblin Society goblins now settling the upper mound.
Why does Sir Alfred, an undead knight whom Brother Dirk regards as holy, haunt the Barrow Mound by Sir Brandon's tomb?
